description: Adds the records Phantom needs to send a promoter's email campaigns from their own domain (SendGrid domain authentication), publish a DMARC monitoring record, and serve tracked links and signup forms from their own hostnames. Applied at the zone; every host is relative to it.
variableDescription: MAILHOST, DKIM1HOST and DKIM2HOST are the sending domain's SendGrid CNAME names relative to the zone (for example em1234.shows, s1._domainkey.shows, s2._domainkey.shows) and MAILTARGET, DKIM1TARGET and DKIM2TARGET the exact targets SendGrid issued for them. DMARCHOST is _dmarc plus the sending subdomain and DMARCVALUE the monitoring-only record (v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=...). CLICKHOST and PUBLICHOST are the promoter's click-tracking and signup-form hostnames relative to the zone; both always point at clicks.itsphantom.com.
